■ Whenever you summon a creature with the "Vividdraw" ability, that creature gets "Speed Attacker" until the end of the turn.
■ Whenever you cast a spell using the "Vividdraw" ability, draw a card.

■ 自分の呪文を「ビビッドロー」能力を使って唱えた時、カードを1枚引く。
